headline: Chilean Government Reaches Wage Agreement with 13 Public Sector Guilds
summary: The Chilean government reached an agreement with 13 of 16 public sector guilds for a 4.6% nominal salary increase covering inflation through November 2026, with legislation to be introduced in Congress.
why: Public sector wage agreements set fiscal spending baselines and influence national wage-price dynamics and labor market expectations.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Public sector salary adjustments affect national fiscal expenditure and inflation expectations.
